name: Orbit
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
                  This is an rd formula that uses an iteration step implemented to treat reagents a and b as a complex number (a+bi) and raise it to a power. Inspired by what a normal orbits-fractal (eg Julia, Mandelbrot) step does.;
[link]</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Orbit" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.05
      </param>
      <param name="clampMin">
        -2
      </param>
      <param name="clampMax">
        2
      </param>
      <param name="constReal">
        -0.09
      </param>
      <param name="constImag">
        0.04
      </param>
      <param name="constRealInner">
        -0.87
      </param>
      <param name="constImagInner">
        -0.16
      </param>
      <param name="realPower">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="imagPower">
        -1
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.14
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.35
      </param>
      <param name="mag_amp">
        2
      </param>
      <param name="mag_power">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_zeroPt">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="phaseOffset">
        0.1
      </param>
      <param name="phaseAmp">
        1
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="4">
                c = pow((a+constRealInner)*(a+constRealInner) + (b+constImagInner)*(b+constImagInner), mag_power) * mag_amp + mag_zeroPt;
d = atan2( b+constRealInner, a+constRealInner ) * phaseAmp + phaseOffset;
delta_a = clamp( timestep * pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352f, -imagPower*d ) * cos( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_a * laplacian_a + constReal, clampMin, clampMax );
delta_b = clamp( timestep * pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352f, -imagPower*d ) * sin( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_b * laplacian_b + constImag, clampMin, clampMax );
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
